title: Kernel Jitter
tagline: Compare four admission control strategies that shape tail-latency under bursty load using different complexity costs.

curves.label: Global Sort Gate
curves.code: requests.sort((a,b)=>a.deadline-b.deadline); accept=0; for(r of requests){ if(accept<capacity) accept++; else drop++; }
curves.name: Global Sort Gate

curves.label: Bucketed Token Buckets
curves.code: for(k=0;k<numBuckets;k++) tokens[k]+=rate; idx=hash(flow)%numBuckets; if(tokens[idx]>1){tokens[idx]--; allow();} else deny();
curves.name: Bucketed Token Buckets

curves.label: Round-Robin Quotas
curves.code: for(i=0;i<n;i++){ flow=flows[i%flows.length]; if(quota[flow]>0){quota[flow]--; allow(flow);} else deny(flow); }
curves.name: Round-Robin Quotas

curves.label: Count-Min Admission
curves.code: for(r of batch){ est=0; for(d=0;d<dCount;d++){ est=Math.min(est, cms[d][h(d,r.key)]); } if(est<threshold) allow(r); else deny(r); for(d=0;d<dCount;d++) cms[d][h(d,r.key)]++; }
curves.name: Count-Min Admission

curves.label: P2 Quantile Reactor
curves.code: initP2(); for(r of stream){ q=estimateQuantile(0.99); if(r.latency<=q) allow(); else throttle(); updateP2(r.latency); }
curves.name: P2 Quantile Reactor
